598:t_4:14.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But if the existence of this monument is made public, the world will be greatly shaken.」

598:t_4:15.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if it belongs to just one of the worlds that make up the multiverse, the people of space will grow ever more suspicious of the organization known as the $$地球連邦$$.」

598:t_4:16.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「With the decisive battle against the $$新地球皇国$$ looming, I can't even imagine what situation that will cause.」

598:t_4:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「At the very least, as the price of a... well-intentioned truth, it's far too...!」

598:t_4:18.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That is why I entrusted this to you... to $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

598:t_4:19.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Because I believed that you are the forerunners who will lead humanity on to its next stage.」

598:t_4:20.en:
$$ガエル$$
「The $$ラプラス・プログラム$$ is a system for identifying true $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

598:t_4:21.en:
$$ガエル$$
「Unlike those of enhanced humans, a true $$ニュータイプ$$'s psychic waves exceed the numbers.」

598:t_4:22.en:
$$ガエル$$
「Whoever it may be, the key that guides a true $$ニュータイプ$$ to the Box... that is the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.」

598:t_4:23.en:
$$ガエル$$
「It was all planned by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$. He never even dreamed of having you pilot it.」

598:t_5:3.en:
$$サイアム$$
「...The time I have waited for all this while has finally come, thanks to you.」

598:t_5:5.en:
$$サイアム$$
「As the Guardian of the Box, crossing a span of time far too long for a single body, I held one wish...」

598:t_5:6.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If $$ニュータイプ$$s truly exist, it is to them that I wanted to entrust the Box...」

598:t_5:7.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I thought that they would use the Box better, and take back the future that ought to be.」

598:t_5:8.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If a technology that can touch the human mind... the human heart... was nearing completion, I wanted to see for myself...」

598:t_5:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So that's... the $$サイコ・フレーム$$...」

598:t_5:10.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But that is my wish... One single wish... and there are as many of them as there are people.」

598:t_5:11.en:
$$サイアム$$
「You may bury the truth and leave the Box unopened, or you may destroy it. Either is fine with me.」

598:t_5:12.en:
$$サイアム$$
「And if that still doesn't satisfy you... you are welcome to beat this old wreck to death.」

598:t_5:14.en:
$$サイアム$$
「What do you wish for? What do you long for in your heart?」

598:t_5:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...If $$ニュータイプ$$s are the new form of humanity... I don't think humans today have the power to tell them apart.」

598:t_5:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So I can't know whether $$オードリー$$ and I... have the qualities you seek, and I don't know what's best either.」

598:t_5:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「As a single human being, I want to believe in what lies beyond... in people... in the possibilities people hold...!」

598:t_5:19.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Then I will believe those words of yours. If you say you will make the contents of the Box public, you must be prepared for that as well.」

598:t_5:20.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... There is one thing I would like to hear your thoughts on.」

598:t_5:21.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Did $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ do this out of guilt toward the space emigrants?」

598:t_5:22.en:
$$サイアム$$
「No, that is not it.」

598:t_5:23.en:
$$サイアム$$
「He was resisting. Resisting what binds this world.」

598:t_5:24.en:
$$バナージ$$
「How can you be so sure of that?」

598:t_5:25.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I did not hide the existence of the Box merely to bargain with the Federation...」

598:t_5:28.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That day... as $$ラプラス$$ was swallowed by flames, I saw something.」

598:t_5:29.en:
$$サイアム$$
「The moment I saw it with my own eyes, I understood the future $$リカルド$$ sought, and why he had to be killed.」

598:t_5:30.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That is the very doctrine of $$クロノ$$... the meaning behind their oppressing the Spacenoids and styling themselves the watchers of humanity's evolution...」

598:t_5:31.en:
$$サイアム$$
「As he proclaimed the dawn of the $$宇宙世紀$$, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ offered a prayer to the future, and tried to make public the existence that has bound us since the distant past.」

598:t_5:32.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... You are...」

598:t_5:33.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Yes. The truth at the very bottom of $$ラプラスの箱$$... is I myself.」

598:t_5:34.en:
$$サイアム$$
「The only human besides $$クロノ$$ who knows its doctrine and can speak of it... That is also the meaning of my having lived on.」

598:t_5:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What... exactly did you see?」

598:t_5:38.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$テンシ$$ that $n saw turned out to be $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

598:t_5:39.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't tell me he was involved in the $$ラプラス事件$$ too...」

598:t_5:42.en:
???
「But you... and humanity... have no need to know the answer to that.」

598:t_5:44.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To disclose $$ラプラスの箱$$ is the same as exposing the doctrine of $$クロノ$$ that lies at its bottom.」

598:t_5:45.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That despair would, if anything, close off possibility... The Box is enough merely by existing.」

598:t_5:47.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I cannot recommend delving any deeper. Leave the rest to me.」

598:t_5:48.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It is for humanity's sake.」

598:t_5:50.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Stand down, $$フル・フロンタル$$. You are merely a man who was built to resemble $$シャア$$ and is trying to fulfill that role.」

598:t_5:51.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The succession of Earth's humanity you speak of is, as far as I am concerned, nothing but the escape of a man who does not believe in humanity's future.」

598:t_5:52.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But that is the collective will of humanity... It is the strength of me, who have become its vessel.」

598:t_5:54.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Head of the $$ビスト家$$, $$サイアム・ビスト$$... As the leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and successor of Earth's humanity, I wish to take custody of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

598:t_5:55.en:
$$サイアム$$
「What you say is not wrong either... So that people may live the reality before their eyes, perhaps the Box should not be opened.」

598:t_5:57.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That is exactly why. Whether the Box is opened must not be left in the hands of people who can only think of it as a bargaining chip.」

598:t_5:58.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Not people like you or me...」

598:t_5:59.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$!」

598:t_5:60.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I do not know what means you used, but you seem to know the true meaning of the Box as well.」

598:t_5:61.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But, other $$赤い彗星$$... knowing that and yet able to do nothing, we cannot advance into the future.」

598:t_5:62.en:
$$サイアム$$
「This is no longer our age... Can you not think that the time has come to entrust it to the children...?」

598:t_5:63.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You are saying that they are the true $$ニュータイプ$$s, the $$イノベイター$$s, the SEEDs, the ones who should advance beyond the civilization of fire?」

598:t_5:64.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Exactly. Entrusting the future to them is the last task for me and for them.」

598:t_5:65.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But that is not what matters. Having traveled the road to the Box, they made their decision. I wish to accept it.」

598:t_5:66.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Understood. Then I will use force to take the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

598:t_5:67.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I will not allow it...!」

598:t_5:68.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A defense system! He doesn't miss a thing, as expected!」

598:t_5:69.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I will strike this $$メガラニカ$$ from the outside!」

598:t_5:70.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

598:t_5:71.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$! Are you all right!?」
